page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries, running head at top; page number at top left. Text runs top to bottom in one column, with a centred letter heading "L." in the middle. Catchword absent.

main_text.p: Juventus, pro ætate] Ætatis ver breve, juventa, Non. Pubertas, Col. Pubes. Bona ætas, Cic. Flos ævi, ætatis, Lucr. Multicupida juventilitas, Varr. Lubricum ætatis, Vlp. Lubricum ætatulæ virentis, Apul. Juventas, Lucr. Juventas est Dea præses juventutis, Hor. Liv. Flos ætatis, Cic.
Juxta] Secundùm mare ire. Proximus Pompejum sedebam, Cic. Prope oppidum. Propter ædem Vulcani, Cic.
Juxtà tempus] Pro ratione temporis. Ut ratio temporis postulabit, Cic. Ad rationem temporis, Plin. Iun. Prout tempus patiebatur, Liv.
Juxta rem ac locum] Pro re ac loco, Salust. Prout res ac locus, ex Liv. Ad rationem loci, Plin.
main_text.head: L.
main_text.p: Labans] Lapsabundus, Sen. Casabundus, Enn. Succiduus gressus, Claud. Prociduus, Plin. Vertilabundus, Varr. Labens domus, Virg.
Labascere] Vacillare. Toto corpore in utramque partem vacillans. Labare, Nutare. Fluctuare, Cic. Vacillat ex vino, Quint. Minatur & nutat ornus accisa, Virg. Collabascere, Lucr. Collabescieri, Caes.
Labefactare] Infringere lilia, Ovid. Infirmare. Frangere alicujus opes. Violare amicitiam, existimationem. Exulcerare gratiam alicujus, Cic. Delumbare, Plin. Delibare aliquid, Varr.
Labeo] Labiosus, Lucr. Labrosus. Broccus, Plin.
Labes] Labecula, Cic. Macula, Plin. Sordes luxuriæ, Juven.
Labilis] Caducus. Ruinosus. Præcipitans Resp. Ad terram fertur, Cic. Vid. Labans.
Labium] Labrum, labellum, Cic. Suavium, vel, Savium, Plaut. Lacuna, Lactant. Nympha, Iun. Valvæ oris.
Labor] Labos, Plaut. Elaboratio operæ. Sudor, Cic.
